howToAdd: Append an object to tools and add a folder at that href with an index.html. Fields: name, description, href, icon (pen, press, bind, or dot), kicker, chapter, line.

tools.name: Edit and Sign PDF
tools.description: Write, cover, highlight, and sign. The file never leaves this browser.
tools.line: Text, white-out, and a signature drawn with a mouse, a finger, or a pen.

tools.name: Reduce PDF file size
tools.description: Shrink a PDF and read the real size of each version before you keep it.
tools.line: Photographs get smaller. Sentences stay sharp, selectable type.

tools.name: Convert images to one PDF
tools.description: A folder of pictures, in order, bound into one document on your machine.
tools.line: Portrait or landscape, one page each, turned when that fits the sheet better.
